'''Ambrian Imperial base''' was a military base of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] a [[Unidentified Rodian slicer|Rodian slicer]] obtained access codes for the base, planning to sell them later.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ambrian Imperial base is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the underworld trading crew skill mission "Access Allowed".
